'Gain 2{h}. If there are 4 or more Earth cards in your banished zone, instead gain 4{h}.' Earth Instant (Rosetta).

SHAPE: one PLAY ability (an Instant played from hand maps PLAY -> ON_PLAY) holding a single CONDITIONAL_EFFECT branch - the 'instead' wording is ONE bonus chosen by the test, never two gated gains (that would deal/gain both). The when-list is evaluated when the effect RUNS, i.e. when Fertile Ground's layer resolves on the stack - exactly the timing official_release_notes line 1 demands ('you must have 4 or more ... when its layer resolves').

CONDITION PARAMS all read by the CARD_IN_ZONE handler (condition_types.py:844-996, read this session): zone 'banished' is the Player attribute lowercased (:935); 'talent' is an alias of card_class (:895-898) matched via _card_traits (:49-64), which unions classes+talents so 'earth' matches Earth cards; count_gte 4 is the >= threshold (:901, :989-993); player defaults SELF = your banished zone.

face_up TRUE implements release-note line 2 ('face-down cards do not count'): the matcher skips cards whose is_public differs from face_up (:973), and banish() only sets is_public=False on explicit face_down banishes (effect_keywords.py:177-180) - normal banishes keep the zone default, so the bonus still fires in the common case.

GAIN asset LIFE_POINTS routes to effect_gain_life (effect_types.py:4890-4896). Amounts 4/2 are this YELLOW printing; the note's '5/4/3' spread is red/yellow/blue and colour variants are separate JSON files.

No printed keywords, nothing else to author.
